newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.127 bln stg week to Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.127 bln stg week to Jan 29.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.127 billion stg in the week to January 29 from 24.980 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 24.376 billion stg from 24.235 billion.
Notes and coin in circulation fell to a seasonally adjusted 24.856 billion stg from 24.891 billion the previous week while on an unadjusted basis they fell to 24.105 billion from 24.146 billion.
